items.name: Training blade
items.description: Balanced default slash. Equip to return to the original moveset.

items.name: Long blade
items.description: Slower, longer slash. Deals more health and posture damage.

items.name: Padded outfit
items.description: Adds 25 maximum HP and reduces incoming HP damage by 20%. Equipping does not heal.

items.name: Posture charm
items.description: Increases ordinary attack posture damage by 25%. Does not modify deflections.

items.name: Healing flask
items.description: Restore 40 HP and 20 unbroken posture. Consumed on use.
